entries.title: Numbers 12:1
segments: ¶Now Miriam and Aaron said evil against Moses, because of the Cushite woman to whom he was married, for he had taken a Cushite woman as his wife.

entries.title: Numbers 12:2
segments: And they said, Have the words of the Lord been given to Moses only? have they not come to us? And the Lord took note of it.

entries.title: Numbers 12:3
segments: Now the man Moses was more gentle than any other man on earth.

entries.title: Numbers 12:4
segments: ¶And suddenly the Lord said to Moses and Aaron and Miriam, Come out, you three, to the Tent of meeting. And the three of them went out.

entries.title: Numbers 12:5
segments: And the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud, taking his place at the door of the Tent, and made Aaron and Miriam come before him.

entries.title: Numbers 12:6
segments: And he said, Now give ear to my words: if there is a prophet among you I will give him knowledge of myself in a vision and will let my words come to him in a dream.

entries.title: Numbers 12:7
segments: My servant Moses is not so; he is true to me in all my house:

entries.title: Numbers 12:8
segments: With him I will have talk mouth to mouth, openly and not in dark sayings; and with his eyes he will see the form of the Lord: why then had you no fear of saying evil against my servant Moses?

entries.title: Numbers 12:9
segments: And burning with wrath against them, the Lord went away.

entries.title: Numbers 12:10
segments: ¶And the cloud was moved from over the Tent; and straight away Miriam became a leper, as white as snow: and Aaron, looking at Miriam, saw that she was a leper.

entries.title: Numbers 12:11
segments: Then Aaron said to Moses, O my lord, let not our sin be on our heads, for we have done foolishly and are sinners.

entries.title: Numbers 12:12
segments: Let her not be as one dead, whose flesh is half wasted when he comes out from the body of his mother.

entries.title: Numbers 12:13
segments: And Moses, crying to the Lord, said, Let my prayer come before you, O God, and make her well.

entries.title: Numbers 12:14
segments: And the Lord said to Moses, If her father had put a mark of shame on her, would she not be shamed for seven days? Let her be shut up outside the tent-circle for seven days, and after that she may come in again.

entries.title: Numbers 12:15
segments: So Miriam was shut up outside the tent-circle for seven days: and the people did not go forward on their journey till Miriam had come in again.

entries.title: Numbers 12:16
segments: After that, the people went on from Hazeroth and put up their tents in the waste land of Paran.
